source.title: General Office of the State Council Notice on the 2026 Public Holiday Arrangements

arrangements.name: New Year's Day
arrangements.source_line: New Year's Day: holiday from Jan 1, 2026 to Jan 3, 2026. Compensated working day(s): Jan 4, 2026.

arrangements.name: Spring Festival
arrangements.source_line: Spring Festival: holiday from Feb 15, 2026 to Feb 23, 2026. Compensated working day(s): Feb 14, 2026, and Feb 28, 2026.

arrangements.name: Qingming Festival
arrangements.source_line: Qingming Festival: holiday from Apr 4, 2026 to Apr 6, 2026.

arrangements.name: Labour Day
arrangements.source_line: Labour Day: holiday from May 1, 2026 to May 5, 2026. Compensated working day(s): May 9, 2026.

arrangements.name: Dragon Boat Festival
arrangements.source_line: Dragon Boat Festival: holiday from Jun 19, 2026 to Jun 21, 2026.

arrangements.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
arrangements.source_line: Mid-Autumn Festival: holiday from Sep 25, 2026 to Sep 27, 2026.

arrangements.name: National Day
arrangements.source_line: National Day: holiday from Oct 1, 2026 to Oct 7, 2026. Compensated working day(s): Sep 20, 2026, and Oct 10, 2026.
